The July AirPods Pro 3 deal at $50 off, AirPods Max 2 at $100 off, and the ongoing all-time low on AirTag 2 are still rolling, but today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break is headlined Apple’s official refurb store – it has the lowest prices on the most affordable M5 MacBook Air models right now at up to $240 off, as detailed right here. Those deals join up to $500 off M5 Pro and M5 Max MacBook Pro models, a new all-time low on David Pogue’s ‘Apple: The First 50 Years’ hardcover book, and a notable $50 launch deal on Sharge’s new transparent metal 24000mAh power bank with RGB smart display. Everything awaits below.

July summer deals on current-gen AirPods starting to go out of stock: AirPods Pro 3, Max 2, and more still up to $100 off

  • AirPods Pro 3 $200 (Reg. $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (Reg. $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (Reg. $129)
  • AirPods 4 with ANC $145 (Reg. $179)
  • AirPods 4 with ANC $119 (Reg. $179 new) – Renewed Premium

July is about to come to a close and that might very well mean this month’s AirPods deals will as well. There are some July sale events scheduled to run through Sunday, so we might see the AirPods Pro 3 discount, AirPods Max 2 at $100 off, and more extend through the weekend, but there’s no telling for sure and the AirPods 4 with ANC deal has already disappeared on Amazon as of this morning.

Black Friday in July ushered in another shot at a series of notable deals on Apple’s current-generation AirPods, not the least of which AirPods Pro 3 at $50 off. However, it also served up a solid $100 price drop on the 2026 AirPods Max 2, and the best price in months on the ANC-equipped AirPods 4. The latter of which has now gone out of stock, and we might see the rest of the lineup follow suit sooner than later.

Apple’s official refurb store has the best deals on M5 MacBook Air, now up to $240 off

The official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is delivering the lowest price on M5 MacBook Air right now. Pricing on the base model M5 13-inch recently went up, but you can score one directly from Apple with a full 1-year warranty down at $1,099 shipped – you can’t even get an open-box model from the big retailers at a price this low – and you’ll other configurations at up to $240 off the list price directly from Apple.

Lowest price for an M5 MacBook Air

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (Reg. $1,299 new)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,359 (Reg. $1,599 new) – $240 off

The official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is now offering the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air at $200 off the new list price. We are looking at the base model and the most affordable configuration you can buy here with 16GB of RAM and the 512GB internal store down at $1,099 shipped here.

More details on the official Apple refurbishment process:

  • Quality products at great prices
  • Rigorous refurbishment process prior to sale
  • Covered by Apple’s one-year limited warranty
  • Covered by Apple’s 14-day returns policy
  • AppleCare product can be purchased
  • Engraving and gift wrap not available for refurbished products
  • Supplies are limited

There was a time when you could score this machine for less, but those days are long gone and it has been very difficult to find any M5 MacBook Pro for less than $1,199 since the price increases.

If you’re looking for the lowest possible price on the M5 MacBook Air from (not) arguably the best and most trustworthy source on the internet, these official Apple Certified Refurbished Store deals are worth consideration.

There might be a time in the future we see Amazon get aggressive with deal pricing on this model in brand new condition, but as of right now, $200+ off right after the price hike has truly taken hold at retail seems unlikely for the immediate future.

Sharge’s new transparent metal 24000mAh power bank with RGB smart display lands at $50 off (Launch deal)

Not all power banks are made equal, some have onboard displays and built-in USB-C cables, and some feature a gorgeously cyberpunk-themed inside-out design that put the electronics on display. Sharge’s new Shargeek 24000mAh Power Bank does just about all of that with the onboard RGB lighting, smart display, and display window into the interworkings of the device. It is also seeing a notable launch deal at $50 off.

The official Sharge Amazon storefront is now offering the brand’s new Shargeek 300W Power Bank with a 24000mAh battery capacity down at $179 shipped – clip the on-page coupon.

This is a regularly $229 conversation-starting charger that is now $50 off to deliver the lowest price we have tracked since it released just over the last couple weeks or so.

If you’re into this kind of thing, this is a seriously impressive looking portable power bank charger. But before we get into the aesthetics, let’s talk specs:

  • 300W Total Output 140W + 140W + 20W for three devices.
  • Dual 140W USB-C PD 3.1 fast charging from either port.
  • 24,000mAh Capacity All-day power for laptops and devices.
  • 5–28V DC Power Built for cameras and creator gear.
  • Carry-On Ready 88.8Wh; airline rules may vary.

Apple’s 20-core 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro is $300 off at Amazon, and this 16-core model is $500 off

While we are still tracking a particularly notable $500 price drop on the 24GB/2TB 15-Core M5 Pro MacBook Pro, folks looking towards the even more powerful 18-Core model can now score it at the best rate since the price hikes went live at $300 off.

Amazon is now offering the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB of RAM and the 2TB storage capacity down at $2,899 shipped. This is now a regularly $3,199 machine with the 18-core CPU and 20-core GPU at $300 off the list price.

This is indeed the lowest price we have tracked at Amazon since the price increases and a solid $300 off at that, but if you don’t need the 18-core CPU and 20-core GPU setup, you can score the same machine with the 15-core CPU and 16-core GPU at a giant $500 off the new list price:

  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB 15-core/16-core $2,499 (Reg. $2,999) – $500 off
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB 18-core/20-core $2,899 (Reg. $3,199) – $300 off

There’s really no telling how much longer that sizable $500 discount will be live, but if you are looking for a MacBook Pro upgrade right now, you’ll definitely want this one on your radar.

Official Apple iPhone Air MagSafe Battery sitting down at $59 Amazon all-time low pricing (40% off)

For all of you iPhone Air users out there, we are touching down this morning to highlight the 40% price drop on the official Apple iPhone Air MagSafe Battery.

Amazon is currently offering the Apple iPhone Air MagSafe Battery down at $59 shipped.

Regularly $99, this is a solid 40% off the list price and what you’ll pay at both Apple and other authorized dealers.

After release alongside Apple’s ultra-thin iPhone Air in September, we started to see some 20% price drops into the $79 range back in mid January before Amazon started to get aggressive with deeper deals on and off beginning in May. Since that time we have seen more than a few chances to land it down at the same Amazon low pricing we have here today.

While it will work with other MagSafe devices, the official MagSafe Battery is specifically designed to fit the back of iPhone Air perfectly. There are more affordable options out there in the product category, but Apple’s is one of the thinnest there is, delivering up to 65% charge to your Air for “all-day use” and streamlined iOS widget support.

Deals on brand new unlocked condition units are tough to come by from reputable sources, but we are still tracking up to $220 off 17 Pro in Amazon’s best quality renewed condition, and Woot is once again highlighting the up to $450 off 17 Pro Max right now.

Over at Amazon you’ll find the 1TB and 512GB iPhone 17 Pro models live again at up to $220 off – these are Amazon Renewed Premium units with a 1-year Amazon Renewed Guarantee and “greater than 90% original battery life.” Standard Amazon refurbished units only come with a 90-day warranty and you don’t get the same battery guarantee either.
